newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total reports Alwyn reserves increase.
newsitem.headline: Total reports Alwyn reserves increase.

text.p: French oil company Total said on Thursday that its drilling campaign undertaken since last year on the Alwyn permit has resulted in a rise in estimated reserves to "nearly one billion" barrels of oil equivalent from previous estimates of 700 million barrels.
Total said the results of the recent drilling along with its exploration strategy in other North Sea permit areas should allow it to increase its reserves under operation in the region.
The Alwyn Permit is operated 33.33 percent by Total and 66.67 percent by Elf Aquitaine.
The reserves estimate includes the Dunbar, Ellon and Grant satellite fields, Total said.
